cases.name: Trecia Spencer Carruthers
cases.about: Nisha Spencer, Carruthers’s younger sister, said her sister was a mother starting her own notary business. She described her as “nothing but helpful and caring” and said the relationship she had with her daughter was one she admired. As the younger sister, Spencer said Carruthers was always her “cool big sister” chaperone. “She’s direct representation of her heart being bigger than her body,” Spencer said.
